newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 26.53 bln bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 26.53 bln bfr.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury's bond exchange auction totalled 26.530 billion francs, the Treasury said in a statement BELE.

At the auction, the Treasury offered OLO lines 13 (7.00 pct April 1999), 7 (9.00 pct June 2001), 24 (7.00 pct May 2006) and 16 (7.50 pct July 2008) in exchange for OLO lines 15 (6.75 pct May 1997) and 8 (9.25 pct August 1997).
The Treasury said 18.100 billion francs of OLO 15 were exchanged for OLO 24 and 8.430 billion francs of OLO 15 were exchanged for OLO 16.
